title: Feature request: SMB enable/disable button
symptom: Users want a button on the main screen to enable/disable SMB, as many people disable SMB at night.
fix: The issue was resolved by a commit, but the thread does not describe the specific fix.
evidence_quote: What if we could have a special button "Enable/disable SMB" button on the main screen, just like Insulin, Carbs, Calculator, CGM?
